description: RMS Live Traffic Cameras is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Roads and Maritime Services. The RMS Transport Management Centre has live traffic cameras strategically located across Sydney's road network in the inner city, North, South and West. The images from the cameras are updated approximately every 60 seconds. Data available to download in GeoJSON and JPEG formats. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Roads and Maritime Services. Its tags are live traffic, road transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in GEOJSON. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
